market_view: The October jobs report (8:30 ET) was hot: +165k payrolls vs ~59k expected, unemployment 4.1%, wages +0.4% m/m, which pushed Treasury yields higher and capped the dip-buying in futures (Nasdaq-100 about +1.6%, S&P 500 about +0.2%) after Thursday's worst Nasdaq day in 19 months. Chips lead the bounce (SMH roughly +5% pre-market) alongside big earnings gaps in ABNB, NET, LRCX and IREN. With VIX near 27 and rate-hike odds rising, sizes are trimmed and every order has a stop.

events.name: US jobs report (October)
events.actual: +165k payrolls vs ~59k expected, unemployment 4.1% vs 4.2%, wages +0.4% m/m (+3.1% y/y) vs +0.3%, September revised up (revisions +84k total)
events.reaction: Treasury yields rose (10-year near 4.9%) and held back equity futures gains; Nasdaq-100 futures about +1.6%, S&P 500 about +0.2% pre-market

events.name: Earnings reaction: ABNB, NET, IREN, LRCX buyback
events.actual: ABNB beat and raised its outlook (+11% pre-market), Cloudflare beat (+15%), IREN beat (+18%), Lam Research announced a $25B buyback (+10%)
events.reaction: Gaps up; Atlassian and Five9 fell

shared_notes: Hot jobs + higher yields: rate-hike odds up, so rate-sensitive longs get tighter stops.
Sam and Vega like the chip bounce but wait for it to hold after the 9:30 open; Dax watches the gappers for clean opening-range breaks.
Fox's gold is a sandbox idea: not possible in your TFSA.

day.view: Gappers everywhere: I wait for the first 15-minute range and only take breaks on volume; two losses and I'm done.

swing.view: ABNB's beat-and-raise is the cleanest earnings gap; I buy it small with the stop under the gap.

orders.why: [Earnings gap-and-hold] Buy ABNB after it beat estimates and raised its outlook (about +11% pre-market); the stop sits just above Thursday's 170 close so a full gap fill costs a small, planned amount, and the size is small because the VIX is 27.

long.view: Quarters, not days: LLY held flat through the rout and passes my growth and margin rules.

orders.why: [Long-term quality] Buy one LLY share: a growth pharma name that did not fall with the AI selloff, with the stop under its recent base.

futures.view: Hot jobs and higher yields are a headwind for gold; I only buy a break above 4,090. Sandbox only: not possible in your TFSA.

orders.why: Buy one micro gold contract only if gold breaks above 4,090 despite higher yields; stop 80 points below. Sandbox: leverage not possible in your TFSA.

options_aggr.view: The chip bounce is tempting, but a hot jobs print can reverse it; one short-dated NVDA call, risk capped by the premium, exit before the Nov 17 earnings.

orders.why: Buy a short-dated NVDA call (a bet it rises) after the chip rebound; the most I can lose is the premium, and I plan to exit before NVDA reports on Nov 17.

options_safe.view: VIX near 27 makes premiums rich, but after a hot jobs print I stay far out of the money and keep half in cash; no new puts until the open settles.

crypto.view: Crypto barely moved (BTC about 75.8k, -0.2%); higher yields are a headwind, so I hold the core and add nothing until the open settles. Sandbox: not possible in your TFSA.
